title: Separated characteristic branches and polarization
source_policy: Independent exposition, complete programme proofs and exact scholarly references.

source_references.title: Lars Hörmander — The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III (reprint of 1994 edition)
source_references.reading_scope: Complete current page read and image inspected: Theorem23.1.4, scalar wavefront/FIO discussion and start of Section23.2. This is the scalar context, not an external proof provider for the several-branch theorem.

changes: Reconnected current complete SY and EC evolution and Hilbert/ordinary calculus proofs, and exact K1-K4 sums, inverses and conic localization.
Proved the binomial recurrence, inverse-square-root identity, positivity and every differentiated matrix-series majorant.
Proved the logarithm/exponential identity and skew-Hermitian logarithm of a near-identity unitary matrix without an unproved functional calculus.
Proved two-sided extra-order norm Taylor estimates for the actual matrix-principal evolution and all smoothing/Bochner parameter derivatives.
Constructed the projected bundle inverse and its overlap agreement; proved non-smoothness of the diagonal rank block for the exact wavefront converse.
Retained all original displays and all four complete exercise solutions, every ordinary symbol and global error estimate, and the original exact figure.
Made the graph inverse explicitly local to an elliptic scalar cutoff and distinguished the uncut bundle transport from that cutoff.
Inserted a second compact spatial cutoff to obtain an actual positive diagonal separation for the exterior PDO tail; proved every global Sobolev bound by compact-row duality and graph mapping.
